words.tr: phrase. 极具争议的；引起巨大争议的
words.ex: The policy is of great controversy.
words.ex_cn: 这项政策引发了巨大争议。
words.en: Causing much discussion or argument; widely debated.

words.tr: phrase. 应该是有用且美观的
words.ex_cn: 这个设计应该既实用又美观。
words.en: Likely to be both helpful and aesthetically pleasing.

words.tr: phrase. 在图书馆会议室里
words.ex: The meeting is in the library conference room.
words.ex_cn: 会议在图书馆的会议室举行。
words.en: In the room designated for meetings within a library.

words.tr: phrase. 有志愿工作；从事无偿的志愿服务工作
words.ex: Many students have volunteer jobs during the summer.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生在夏天有志愿者工作。
words.en: To engage in unpaid work for an organization or cause.

words.tr: 介词短语，指‘就社会与经济背景而言’或‘涉及社会与经济背景’
words.ex: The results vary according to social and economic background.
words.ex_cn: 结果因社会与经济背景而异。
words.en: Relating to both the social and financial circumstances of a person or group.

words.tr: phrase. 在讲座之后
words.ex: We went for coffee after the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我们在讲座之后去喝了咖啡。
words.en: Following the lecture.

words.w: in the final week of the term
words.tr: phrase. phr. 在学期最后一周
words.uk: /ɪn ðə ˈfaɪnəl wiːk əv ðə tɜːm/
words.us: /ɪn ðə ˈfaɪnəl wik əv ðə tɜrm/
words.ex: He finished his homework in the final week of the term.
words.ex_cn: 他在学期的最后一周完成了作业。
words.en: During the last seven days of an academic term.

words.tr: phrase. 去见图书管理员
words.ex: I need to meet the librarian to return my overdue books.
words.ex_cn: v. 我需要去见图书管理员归还我逾期的书籍。
words.en: To have a meeting with the person in charge of a library.

words.tr: phrase. 社会成员；社会中的一份子
words.ex: All members of society should contribute to its betterment.
words.ex_cn: 社会所有成员都应该为社会的改善做出贡献。
words.en: Individuals who are part of a community or society, sharing its culture, institutions, and interests.

words.w: by the end of the day
words.tr: 短语. 到一天结束时；最迟在今天之内；最终
words.uk: baɪ ði end əv ðə deɪ
words.us: baɪ ði end əv ðə deɪ
words.ex: By the end of the day, he finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 到一天结束时，他完成了作业。
words.en: Before the day is over; ultimately.

words.tr: phrase. 通过一个提交表格
words.ex: He sent his application by a submission form.
words.ex_cn: 他通过提交表格递交了申请。
words.en: via an online or paper form used to collect information

words.tr: phrase. 输入、输出与反馈（指系统或流程中接收的信息、产生的结果以及基于结果进行的回馈信息）
words.ex: The machine takes inputs, gives outputs, and needs feedback.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器接收输入，给出输出，并需要反馈。
words.en: the data entered, the results produced, and the response received

words.tr: 介词短语：前往院系办公室
words.ex: He walked to the faculty office after class.
words.ex_cn: 他下课后去了教员办公室。
words.en: to the administrative office of a university department

words.tr: phrase. 由政府
words.ex: The project was funded by the government.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目由政府资助。
words.en: by the national governing authority

words.tr: 短语. 应在明天之前完成或到期
words.ex: The homework are due by tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 作业必须在明天之前交。
words.en: Must be completed or submitted by the day after today.

words.w: the part of education is funding
words.tr: phrase. 教育的一部分是资金支持
words.uk: ðə pɑːt əv ɪdʒuˈkeɪʃn ɪz ˈfʌndɪŋ
words.us: ðə pɑrt əv ɪdʒuˈkeɪʃn ɪz ˈfʌndɪŋ
words.ex: The part of education is funding from the government.
words.ex_cn: 教育的一部分是政府的资金支持。
words.en: funding is a component of the educational system

words.tr: phrase. 我们的观点是……；我们认为
words.ex: Our view is that education should be free for everyone.
words.ex_cn: phrase. 我们的观点是教育应该对所有人免费。
words.en: Our opinion or belief is that.

words.tr: phrase. 不可避免的责任
words.ex: Taking care of your parents is an unavoidable responsibility.
words.ex_cn: 照顾你的父母是一种不可避免的责任。
words.en: A duty or obligation that cannot be escaped or avoided.

words.tr: phrase. 植物生长的过程
words.ex: The process of plant growth takes many weeks.
words.ex_cn: 植物生长的过程需要很多周。
words.en: The series of changes that a plant undergoes from the beginning of its life until it reaches maturity, involving cell division, elongation, and differentiation.

words.tr: phrase. 演示的要素；展示的组成部分
words.ex: The clear structure is an element of presentation.
words.ex_cn: 清晰的结构是演示的要素。
words.en: a component of a formal talk or display

words.tr: phrase. 在截止日期之前
words.ex: He finished his homework before the deadlines.
words.ex_cn: 他在截止日期前完成了作业。
words.en: Prior to the deadlines; in advance of the set time limits.

words.tr: phrase. 批判性地思考；以批判性思维进行分析和评估
words.ex: He learns to think critically about problems.
words.ex_cn: 他学习如何对问题进行批判性思考。
words.en: To think critically means to analyze and evaluate an issue in order to form a judgment. It involves the objective analysis and evaluation of facts to form a judgment.

words.tr: 短语. 提前两周
words.ex: You need to book the tickets two weeks in advance to get the early bird discount.
words.ex_cn: phrase. 你需要提前两周订票才能享受早鸟折扣。
words.en: phrase. Doing something two weeks before it is due or needed.

words.tr: 短语动词(has a influence on) 对……有影响，此处指对销售产生影响
words.ex: The weather has a influence on sales of ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 天气对冰淇淋的销售有影响。
words.en: exerts an effect on the volume of goods sold

words.tr: phrase. 难以获得；很难得到
words.ex: Fresh water is hard to obtain in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 在沙漠中，淡水很难获得。
words.en: is difficult to acquire or secure

words.tr: phrase. 所有生命形式；包括地球上存在的各种生物，如动物、植物、微生物等
words.ex: The conservation efforts aim to protect all forms of life in the rainforest.
words.ex_cn: 保护努力旨在保护雨林中的所有生命形式。
words.en: All forms of life refers to every living organism existing on Earth, encompassing the vast diversity of species in various ecosystems.

words.tr: phrase. 从城镇搬到乡村；由城市迁往村庄
words.ex: They moved from towns to villages to live a quiet life.
words.ex_cn: 他们从城镇搬到了村庄，过上宁静的生活。
words.en: relocated from urban areas to rural settlements

words.tr: phrase. 失业率的大幅上升
words.ex: The government is concerned about a big rise in unemployment.
words.ex_cn: 政府担心失业率的大幅上升。
words.en: A significant increase in the number of people who are unemployed.

words.tr: phrase. 将被检查；将被审查；将被考试（被动语态结构）
words.ex: The results will be examined by the doctor tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 医生明天会检查这些结果。
words.en: Will be examined means that something is scheduled or expected to be looked at or inspected in the future.
